notes: The seven cross-dataset duplicate source images between sofa_v3 and sofa_v2_component were deduplicated to prevent train/validation leakage.
All three source class vocabularies were normalized to the seven-class master vocabulary.
The old six-class dataset was remapped so its class IDs match the master vocabulary.
Seven YOLO bounding-box annotations were converted to rectangular segmentation polygons because the merged dataset is kept in YOLO segmentation format.
